message.content: In the conversation, LiHua and AdamSmith discuss setting a time for installing the curtain together. LiHua suggests setting the time for "this week," and AdamSmith agrees, stating he's "free most evenings." Later, AdamSmith proposes a specific Wednesday at 5 pm, and LiHua accepts this suggestion. Therefore, LiHua and AdamSmith agree to install the curtain on Wednesday.
